# PROVEN TO DELIVER

# **PERFORMANCE AT SCALE**

Biopharma manufacturers need to move fast, scale confidently, and maintain the highest quality—all
while reducing risk and complexity.

Development through production, ABEC delivers bioprocess solutions that accelerate time to market,
improve productivity, and deliver measurable, repeatable results.

[HOW WE WORK][30]

## Engineered for Faster
## Time to Market

At ABEC, performance isn’t a promise—it’s proven.

ABEC delivers proven biopharmaceutical manufacturing solutions that seamlessly scale, achieve higher
batch-to-batch reproducibility, and reduce time to market. Precision engineering, validated
performance, and five decades of process expertise help you consistently produce more.

We don’t just deliver equipment, we deliver lasting, valuable outcomes. Every bioprocess system we
design is built to enable measurable gains in yield, uptime, and reliability.

[CASE STUDIES][31]
[Custom Single Run (CSR) Solutions]

# PROVEN TO DELIVER

# **SEAMLESS SOLUTIONS**

From process development to full commercial manufacturing, ABEC systems maintain design continuity
and process fidelity at every scale. Whether [single-use][32], [stainless-steel][33], or
[hybrid][34], our solutions grow with your science—expanding capacity without adding rework or
compromise.

[SOLUTIONS][35]

## Proven to Deliver
## **Long-Term Value**

Performance doesn’t stop at startup—ABEC’s global service and support network sustains reliability
for decades of value. Our bioprocess engineers deliver preventive maintenance, performance
optimization, and rapid response anywhere in the world, minimizing downtime and keeping you
operating at full capacity.

[SERVICE & SUPPORT][48]

# SERVICE & SUPPORT

ABEC supports you through every expansion, retrofit, and modernization, ensuring that systems scale
smoothly and remain fully optimized across sites and geographies. Lifecycle programs and engineering
support help expand capacity without disruption or risk to ongoing production.

## Healthcare Professionals

Committed to helping you enhance your practice and the experience of your patients through connected
devices and digitalised data sharing.

[Healthcare Professionals][9]
* [ Primary Care ][10]
  
  Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
  vitals monitoring and vision screening
* [ Hospital Care ][11]
  
  Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
  workflows
* [ Surgical Care ][12]
  
  Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
  outcomes
* [ Nutritional Care ][13]
  
  Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and
  at home
* [ Respiratory Health ][14]
  
  Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve
  mobility
* [ Our Products & Services ][15]
  
  Our portfolio of acute, nutritional, hospital and surgical care products helps advance healthcare
  around the world.

For nearly a century, we have worked at the intersection of saving and sustaining lives.

[Perspectives][16]
* [ Patients' Stories ][17]
  
  Patients’ journeys inspire our work and drive our commitment.

  We are a community of diverse professionals working together to drive better healthcare options.

  Enriching the communities where we live and work.

## Our Story

Our 90-year heritage gives us distinct perspective on the needs of patients and caregivers. We lead
today by putting those insights to work to deliver new, better healthcare solutions and access to
care in the communities where we live and work.

[Our Story][21]
* [ Our Leadership ][22]
  
  Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet the needs of all our
  stakeholders – every day and everywhere.
* [ Our Governance ][23]
  
  We are proud of our strong commitment to maintaining the highest standards of corporate
  governance.
* [ Fueling Collaborative Innovation ][24]
  
  Nurturing a culture of innovation is critical to delivering on our mission to save and sustain
  lives. We partner with the healthcare community to continually find more efficient, smarter ways
  to help solve the world's most pressing healthcare challenges.
* [ Baxter Sustainability ][25]
  
  We strive to create lasting value by delivering sustainable healthcare, advancing climate and
  resiliency, and championing our people and communities.
* [ Inclusion & Diversity ][26]
  
  We are committed to attracting, motivating and retaining an inclusive and diverse workforce.
* [ Our History ][27]
  
  For nearly a century, we’ve been focused on saving and sustaining lives and elevating patient
  care.

Helping you reach a healthy life, full of possibility.

[Patients][28]
* [ General Healthcare ][29]
  
  Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
  support every step of your journey.
* [ Nutritional Care ][30]
  
  When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide life-saving
  clinical nutrition options to help you regain your nutritional status.
* [ Respiratory Health ][31]
  
  We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven
  respiratory therapy in the hospital and at home.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

[See how we’re connecting care][52]


[Patient pictured kneeling next to her Golden Retriever]
[Patient Story][53]

### From Pump to Pup: Finding Comfort in 'Baxter'

Izzy, a young cancer fighter and survivor, loves her dog, Baxter, named after the brand she saw on
the infusion pumps that delivered her chemotherapy.

[Read More][54]
[nurse smiling and standing next to a window ]
[Healthcare Insights][55]

### Technology and Service Support Chronic Disease Management at Home

Conditions such as hypertension, respiratory illnesses and cardiac issues can be monitored
effectively with innovative tools and connected devices.

[Read More][56]
[group event at a baseball game]
[People of Baxter][57]

### The Power of Teamwork to Support Patient Care

Teams bridged the pandemic and borders to bring an innovative ICU bed to life.

[Read More][58]
[Collage of images showing innovations in a manufacturing setting]
[Healthcare Insights][59]

### Supply Chain Innovation Delivers More Nimble, Efficient Solutions

Leaders from Baxter speak about our evolutions in manufacturing and supply chain processes as we
emerge from the COVID-19 pandemic

[Read More][60]
[Kim sitting at her desk smiling]
[People of Baxter][61]

### A Teacher at Heart

After losing her parents to heart disease, Kim resolved to share her knowledge about cardiac
monitoring with HCPs to identify potential issues early.

[Read More][62]
[Chabot graphic]
[Healthcare Insights][63]

### Dr. Chatbot Will See You Now

What role will AI play in healthcare in the future? We believe there are realistic opportunities for
AI to make healthcare more efficient and effective

[Read More][64]
[ Press Release ][65]

### Baxter Publishes 2025 Sustainability Report Highlighting Refreshed Strategy, Ongoing Commitment
### to Drive Meaningful Impact

[Read More][66]
[ Press Release ][67]

### Baxter Reports First-Quarter 2026 Results

[Read More][68]
[ Press Release ][69]

### Baxter Showcases Recent Innovations at AORN Global Surgical Conference and Expo 2026

[Read More][70]

## Our Commitment to Healthcare Professionals and Patients

We are committed to supporting patients and healthcare professionals with innovations that are
driven by compassion for their journeys, a passion to improve care and the ambition to transform the
future of healthcare.

[A doctor in a hospital room looks off to the side]

## Products for Healthcare Professionals

### Primary Care [ Primary Care Go to Primary Care ][71]

Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
vitals monitoring and vision screening

[ Go to Primary Care ][72]

### Hospital Care [ Hospital Care Go to Hospital Care ][73]

Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
workflows

[ Go to Hospital Care ][74]

### Surgical Care [ Surgical Care Go to Surgical Care ][75]

Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
outcomes

[ Go to Surgical Care ][76]

### Nutritional Care [ Nutritional Care Go to Nutritional Care ][77]

Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and at
home

[ Go to Nutritional Care ][78]

### Respiratory Care [ Respiratory Care Go to Respiratory Care ][79]

Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve mobility

[ Go to Respiratory Care ][80]

### Our Products [ Our Products Go to Our Products ][81]

Enabling clinicians to treat patients more efficiently and effectively across care settings,
including in the office-based practice, inpatient care, outpatient care and at home

[ Go to Our Products ][82]
[Two ladies have a discussion in a coffee shop]

## For Patients

You are our passion. Your stories inspire us to work harder at bringing innovations that can make
your experience easier, speed recovery and enable the best possible quality of life.

[Discover Patient Stories][83]

### More For Patients

### General Healthcare [ General Healthcare Go to General Healthcare ][84]

Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
support every step of your journey.

[ Go to General Healthcare ][85]

### Nutritional Care [ Nutritional Care Go to Nutritional Care ][86]

When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide clinical nutrition
options to help you regain your nutritional status.

[ Go to Nutritional Care ][87]

### Respiratory Care [ Respiratory Care Go to Respiratory Care ][88]

We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven respiratory
therapy in the hospital and at home.

[ Go to Respiratory Care ][89]

## Bringing our Purpose to Life

Our mission to save and sustain lives is reflected in our business priorities and our commitment to
be an agent of change at a global level. This means doing what is right for our planet, our patients
and customers, our teams and our communities. We put this commitment into action through high-impact
philanthropy, diversity, equity and inclusion, nurturing partnerships with the healthcare community
and striving for the highest standards of corporate responsibility.

### Our Leadership

Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet our commitments – every
day and everywhere.

[Learn More About Our Leadership][90]

### Our Corporate Responsibility

For nearly a century, we have made a meaningful difference in global healthcare while creating
lasting value for the communities we serve.

[Learn More About Our Corporate Responsibility][91]

### Careers

This is where an inclusive community of diverse individuals is driven to go beyond what is, to what
is possible in healthcare.

[Learn More About Careers at Baxter][92]

### Our History

For more than 90 years, we’ve been focused on our commitment to save and sustain lives with
innovations that elevate patient care, improve outcomes and drive healthcare transformation.

[Learn More About Our History][93]

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

# Empowering Scientists and Clinicians to Reach Better Answers

We believe better science starts with better solutions. From discovery through translational
research to clinical applications, we empower scientists and clinicians to advance science faster.

### Introducing Our Portfolio of Brands:

[R&D Systems by Bio-Techne Logo]

With decades of innovation and attentive support, our trusted protein analysis reagents and
instruments enable science to move forward with confidence.

[Discover R&D Systems →][156]
[Bio-Techne Spatial Logo]

From tissue to insight, our targeted spatial biology solutions enable clear, confident decisions
across biomarker discovery, translational research, and patient care.

[Discover Bio-Techne Spatial →][157]
[Bio-Techne Diagnostics Logo]

When results matter most, clinical labs and assay developers rely on our precision product suite and
expertise to deliver consistent, accurate answers that enable confident decisions.

[Discover Bio-Techne Diagnostics →][158]
[Intro Section Image]

## Advancing Science and Medicine

For 50 years, we have supported your breakthroughs, providing the products, tools, and scientific
partnership you need to test ideas, replicate results, and prove the impossible. Guided by our
mission, we improve quality of life worldwide by catalyzing advances in science and medicine.

[Get To Know Bio-Techne][159]

## Introducing Our Portfolio Brands at AACR & AAI

## Explore Our Expansive Applications

### Proteomic Applications

[Proteomic Applications]

Access tools that reveal protein behavior, from expression to interactions, to advance disease
insights, biomarker discovery, and therapeutic development.

[Learn More →][173]

### Cell-Based Therapies

[Cell-Based Therapies]

Providing reliable phase-appropriate reagents and flexible technologies, along with expert support,
to streamline development and scale-up manufacturing processes.

[Learn More →][174]

### Spatial Biology

[Spatial Biology]

Enabling scalable and reliable workflows for RNA, protein, and multiomic detection with our
best-in-class reagents, instruments, and analysis solutions.

[Learn More →][175]

### Precision Diagnostics

[Precision Diagnostics]

Delivering quality controls, reagents, and assay development & manufacturing, plus molecular kits
that simplify workflows and resolve hard-to-detect targets.

[Learn More →][176]
[Quote Icon]

Bio-Techne tools are having quite a significant impact on life science research, and they're able to
help accelerate discoveries by making complex analysis more accessible and reliable.

## More Than a CDMO

### The End-to-End Support of Your Portfolio

[lab safety]

## Pre-Clinical

Partner with us for cell line and strain development, manufacturability assessments, cell banking
and toxicology material generation. Let us guide your path to IND/IMPD submission.

[Why should FUJIFILM Biotechnologies be your Partners for Life?][80]
[doctor reassuring her senior patient]

## Clinical Phase I, II

Partner with us to develop your initial clinical process for cGMP drug substance and drug product
manufacturing.

[Why should FUJIFILM Biotechnologies be your Partners for Life?][81]
[doctor asking senior patient health questions]

## Clinical Phase III

Partner with us to optimize, scale and characterize your process to meet anticipated therapeutic
demands.

[Why should FUJIFILM Biotechnologies be your Partners for Life?][82]
[Family bonding time on the couch]

## Commercialization

Partner with us for process validation and process performance qualification. Leverage our CMC and
regulatory services for your BLA/MAA submission and experience our reliability.

[Why should FUJIFILM Biotechnologies be your Partners for Life?][83]

## More Than a CDMO

### The End-to-End Support of Your Portfolio

[lab safety]

## Pre-Clinical

Partner with us for cell line and strain development, manufacturability assessments, cell banking
and toxicology material generation. Let us guide your path to IND/IMPD submission.

[Why should FUJIFILM Biotechnologies be your Partners for Life?][80]
[doctor reassuring her senior patient]

## Clinical Phase I, II

Partner with us to develop your initial clinical process for cGMP drug substance and drug product
manufacturing.

[Why should FUJIFILM Biotechnologies be your Partners for Life?][81]
[doctor asking senior patient health questions]

## Clinical Phase III

Partner with us to optimize, scale and characterize your process to meet anticipated therapeutic
demands.

[Why should FUJIFILM Biotechnologies be your Partners for Life?][82]
[Family bonding time on the couch]

## Commercialization

Partner with us for process validation and process performance qualification. Leverage our CMC and
regulatory services for your BLA/MAA submission and experience our reliability.

[Why should FUJIFILM Biotechnologies be your Partners for Life?][83]

# Making the Medicines of Tomorrow

As a dedicated CDMO serving the healthcare industry, we bring life-enhancing and life-saving
treatments to market for our customers and their patients. We are a pioneer and world leader in the
CDMO industry, setting the pace with cutting-edge science, smart technology, and lean manufacturing.
United by a common purpose, we turn our customers’ breakthrough innovations into viable therapies
and manufacture the medicines of tomorrow.

Founded in Switzerland in 1897, our company is the first and original CDMO. Today, we bring together
a team of 20,000 colleagues across five continents to deliver integrated offerings that meet the
complex needs of our global customer community.

# Making the Medicines of Tomorrow

As a dedicated CDMO serving the healthcare industry, we bring life-enhancing and life-saving
treatments to market for our customers and their patients. We are a pioneer and world leader in the
CDMO industry, setting the pace with cutting-edge science, smart technology, and lean manufacturing.
United by a common purpose, we turn our customers’ breakthrough innovations into viable therapies
and manufacture the medicines of tomorrow.

Founded in Switzerland in 1897, our company is the first and original CDMO. Today, we bring together
a team of 20,000 colleagues across five continents to deliver integrated offerings that meet the
complex needs of our global customer community.

## **High‑Performance Gas Filtration with Lower CAPEX**

 

Pall’s High Flow Gas solution delivers reliable particulate removal for large‑volume gas streams
while helping operators lower upfront CAPEX. Smaller vessels and fewer elements reduce footprint and
maintenance demands while protecting downstream equipment and supporting long‑term performance.

 

[
Learn More High‑Performance Gas Filtration
][53]

## **Revolutionizing Filtration for the Food & Beverage Industry**

 

Membralox® GP-IC ceramic membrane systems deliver cleaner, more efficient processing with less waste
and downtime. Designed for demanding applications, they help manufacturers transform premium
ingredients and alternative protein production while reducing footprint and cost.

 

[
Learn More Membralox GP-IC
][54]

## **Supralon^{®} Replacement Oil Filter Elements**

 

With high efficiency and consistent performance, our Supralon Filter Elements enable customers to
rapidly achieve and maintain required cleanliness levels that protect lube and hydraulic systems
against component failure and unscheduled downtime that can cost tens of thousands of dollars per
hour.

 

[
Learn More Visit Supralon
][55]

### Passionate About Solving Your Toughest Challenges



Since 1946, Pall has pushed the limits of science and technology to tackle the most complex
filtration, separation, and purification challenges. From safeguarding health and critical assets to
improving quality and reducing waste, we collaborate with customers to turn the unsolvable into
solutions that drive progress.

The Manufacturability Gap

# The science is ready.
# The equipment usually isn't.

That's the problem Alphinity was built to solve.

New therapies are failing in manufacturing, not in the lab. Fragile modalities. Viscous
formulations. Unstable TMP. Scale-up failure. Alphinity designs the fluid handling systems that
solve these problems at the source.

[Meet TFFi™. Our single-use TFF system][24] [Join our Prove-It campaign][25]
[ [INTERPHEX 2026 Best Technologies Innovation Award] ][26]

**Enabling Abundance in Medicine**™. Precision fluid handling for the therapies that matter most.

Process-First Engineering

## Your process.
## Our starting point.

Every piece of Alphinity equipment is designed around a specific process challenge. Four territories
where conventional fluid handling consistently fails, and where our technology makes the difference.

01

### Fragile Modalities

Viral vectors, cell therapies, exosomes, LNPs. Standard processing loses 20 to 40% of AAV titer to
mechanical damage. Our single-use diaphragm pump eliminates the root cause: positive displacement
with no product contact with moving parts.

02

### Viscous Formulations

High-concentration mAbs, dense biologics, viscous buffers, and intensified processes. Conventional
pumping technologies cannot maintain reliable flow above ~500 cP. Our diaphragm pump handles up to
3,000 cP with flow rate independent of viscosity and backpressure.

03

### Process Control

Unstable transmembrane pressure leads to membrane fouling, inconsistent flux, and failed batches.
Near-pulseless diaphragm pumping combined with our electric diaphragm valve delivers the
precision-controlled flow that sensitive processes demand.

04

### Scale-Up Failure

Processes that work at bench scale fail in manufacturing because the mechanical conditions change
with scale. Alphinity's platform maintains identical flow behavior from 30 mL screening to 10 L
clinical batches. No process redesign.

Solutions by modality

## Equipment that matches the modality.

The same TFF skid that works for monoclonal antibodies will tear apart a viral vector. Alphinity
equipment is engineered around the modality being made, not the modality biopharma made twenty years
ago.

Small-batch, closed-system compatible, autologous-friendly. Built for the scales gene therapy

The Fundamentals Hub

## The engineering behind the equipment.

Process science from the Alphinity engineering team. Plain English explanations of why fluid
handling matters as much as the molecule it carries, organized by the three areas where the
questions keep coming back.

[
Pump Science

### How a pump moves fluid, and what it does to the molecule on the way through.

Positive displacement, peristaltic, and centrifugal designs. Shear, cavitation, pulsation,
viscosity, and scale-up. The discipline behind why two pumps rated for the same flow rate can do
very different things to your product.

Explore pump science ›
][38] [
Valve Engineering

### How a valve controls flow and keeps a process closed.

Diaphragm, pinch, and check designs, across single-use and stainless multi-use. Hold-up volume, dead
leg, actuation, and closure dynamics. The discipline behind clean, closed, controlled transitions
between unit operations.

Explore valve engineering ›
][39] [
TFF Science

### How a TFF system concentrates the molecule without compromising it.

Transmembrane pressure, concentration polarization, flux decline, gel layer dynamics, and skid
architecture. The discipline behind concentration and diafiltration that protects the molecule, not
just retains it.

Explore TFF science ›
][40]

The Manufacturability Gap

# The science is ready.
# The equipment usually isn't.

That's the problem Alphinity was built to solve.

New therapies are failing in manufacturing, not in the lab. Fragile modalities. Viscous
formulations. Unstable TMP. Scale-up failure. Alphinity designs the fluid handling systems that
solve these problems at the source.

[Meet TFFi™. Our single-use TFF system][24] [Join our Prove-It campaign][25]
[ [INTERPHEX 2026 Best Technologies Innovation Award] ][26]

**Enabling Abundance in Medicine**™. Precision fluid handling for the therapies that matter most.

Process-First Engineering

## Your process.
## Our starting point.

Every piece of Alphinity equipment is designed around a specific process challenge. Four territories
where conventional fluid handling consistently fails, and where our technology makes the difference.

01

### Fragile Modalities

Viral vectors, cell therapies, exosomes, LNPs. Standard processing loses 20 to 40% of AAV titer to
mechanical damage. Our single-use diaphragm pump eliminates the root cause: positive displacement
with no product contact with moving parts.

02

### Viscous Formulations

High-concentration mAbs, dense biologics, viscous buffers, and intensified processes. Conventional
pumping technologies cannot maintain reliable flow above ~500 cP. Our diaphragm pump handles up to
3,000 cP with flow rate independent of viscosity and backpressure.

03

### Process Control

Unstable transmembrane pressure leads to membrane fouling, inconsistent flux, and failed batches.
Near-pulseless diaphragm pumping combined with our electric diaphragm valve delivers the
precision-controlled flow that sensitive processes demand.

04

### Scale-Up Failure

Processes that work at bench scale fail in manufacturing because the mechanical conditions change
with scale. Alphinity's platform maintains identical flow behavior from 30 mL screening to 10 L
clinical batches. No process redesign.

Solutions by modality

## Equipment that matches the modality.

The same TFF skid that works for monoclonal antibodies will tear apart a viral vector. Alphinity
equipment is engineered around the modality being made, not the modality biopharma made twenty years
ago.

[
[AAV capsid 3D render]

### Viral vectors & AAV

TFF that preserves capsid integrity. Pump architecture that does not shear what it carries.
Single-use end to end.

Read more ›
][27] [
[mRNA molecule 3D render]

### mRNA

Sterile filtration, concentration, and buffer exchange engineered around the chemistry and the
stability window mRNA actually has.

Read more ›
][28] [
[Lipid nanoparticle cutaway render]

### Lipid nanoparticles

Concentration and TFF without compromising the lipid bilayer. Shear and pulsation managed at the
architecture level.

Read more ›
][29] [
[CAR-T cell render with engineered receptor detail]

### Cell & gene therapy

Small-batch, closed-system compatible, autologous-friendly. Built for the scales gene therapy
actually runs at.

Read more ›
][30] [
[IgG monoclonal antibody Y-structure render]

### Proteins & mAbs

Single-use TFF, low-shear pumping, and process equipment for recombinant proteins and monoclonal
antibodies at every scale.

Read more ›
][31] [
[Plasmid DNA circular double-helix render]

### Plasmid DNA

Upstream of viral vector and mRNA. TFF and filtration for GMP plasmid production at the scale and
purity downstream programs depend on.

Read more ›
][32]

Motorized, pneumatic, and manual pinch valves. Clamp-on design, visible position indicator,
compatible with all standard single-use tubing.

[Explore ARTēVA® ›][36]

Fluid Handling

### Buffer Dilution: Single-Use Inline Buffer Management

Inline buffer dilution that replaces large-volume buffer prep tanks. Closed-system, single-use,
designed for the footprint and flexibility modern facilities actually run on.

[Explore Buffer Dilution][37]

The Fundamentals Hub

## The engineering behind the equipment.

Process science from the Alphinity engineering team. Plain English explanations of why fluid
handling matters as much as the molecule it carries, organized by the three areas where the
questions keep coming back.

[
Pump Science

### How a pump moves fluid, and what it does to the molecule on the way through.

Positive displacement, peristaltic, and centrifugal designs. Shear, cavitation, pulsation,
viscosity, and scale-up. The discipline behind why two pumps rated for the same flow rate can do
very different things to your product.

Explore pump science ›
][38] [
Valve Engineering

### How a valve controls flow and keeps a process closed.

Diaphragm, pinch, and check designs, across single-use and stainless multi-use. Hold-up volume, dead
leg, actuation, and closure dynamics. The discipline behind clean, closed, controlled transitions
between unit operations.

Explore valve engineering ›
][39] [
TFF Science

### How a TFF system concentrates the molecule without compromising it.

Transmembrane pressure, concentration polarization, flux decline, gel layer dynamics, and skid
architecture. The discipline behind concentration and diafiltration that protects the molecule, not
just retains it.

Explore TFF science ›
][40]
[Browse the Fundamentals hub][41]

Bespoke Systems

## Built around your process.
## Not the other way around.

Standard systems force your process to adapt to the equipment. We start with your process
constraints (flow behavior, pressure sensitivity, viscosity, scale) and engineer a system that fits.
PIXER® pumps, VannX™ valves, and ConSynSys™ automation as building blocks.

[Learn about bespoke systems][42]

Test & Commission, Support & Service]

The same engineering team designs both. For teams running hybrid lines, that means one design

## Celebrating 27 years of serving Australia’s scientific industry

ASIS Scientific Pty Ltd. was established in 1997 by Gabriel Xiourouppa (BSc), and has developed and
grown into the largest South Australian owned and operated laboratory supply company.

ASIS Scientific supplies an extensive range of laboratory and technical products and services that
include chemicals, equipment, glassware, plasticware, filtration products, general lab consumables,
post-sale servicing, equipment calibration, and laboratory consulting.

# Technology Infrastructure Engineered for Business Growth

BG HANDYMAN LLC delivers enterprise-grade computer systems design, network architecture, and managed
integration services that keep your operations secure, scalable, and relentlessly online.

What We Do

## Comprehensive Systems Integration

From architecture and deployment to ongoing optimization, we deliver end-to-end technology solutions
that align with your business objectives.

🖥

### Computer Systems Design

Custom infrastructure blueprints engineered for performance, redundancy, and cost efficiency. We
assess your workloads and architect systems that scale with your business.

🌐

### Network Architecture

Secure, high-throughput network designs spanning LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, and wireless. Every topology is
documented, tested, and optimized for zero-downtime operation.

☁

### Cloud Migration & Hybrid

Seamless transitions to AWS, Azure, or private cloud environments. We handle workload assessment,
data migration, and post-migration validation with minimal disruption.

🛡

### Cybersecurity Hardening

Multi-layered defense strategies including endpoint protection, intrusion detection, SIEM
integration, and compliance-ready audit trails for regulated industries.

📈

### Managed IT Operations

24/7 monitoring, patch management, backup orchestration, and help desk escalation. Proactive
maintenance that prevents outages before they impact your users.

🔧

### System Integration & API

Connecting disparate platforms through custom middleware, RESTful APIs, and message queues. Unified
data flows that eliminate manual reconciliation and siloed reporting.

Who We Serve

## Industries We Power

Specialized expertise across regulated, high-availability, and data-intensive sectors where system
reliability is non-negotiable.

#### Healthcare & Life Sciences

HIPAA-compliant infrastructure, EHR integration, and secure telemedicine platforms designed for
clinical workflows and patient data protection.

#### Financial Services & Fintech

Low-latency trading infrastructure, PCI-DSS compliant payment systems, and SOC 2-ready architectures
for banking, insurance, and investment platforms.

#### Logistics & Supply Chain

Real-time inventory tracking, warehouse management system integration, and route optimization
engines that reduce operating costs and improve delivery SLAs.

#### Professional Services

Document management systems, CRM deployments, and unified communications platforms for legal,
accounting, and consulting firms with demanding confidentiality requirements.

#### Manufacturing & Industrial

SCADA integration, IoT sensor networks, and predictive maintenance dashboards connecting factory
floors to executive visibility in real time.

#### Retail & E-Commerce

Omnichannel POS integration, inventory synchronization, and CDN-accelerated storefronts engineered
for Black Friday-scale traffic without performance degradation.

About Us

## Engineering Reliability Into Every System

BG HANDYMAN LLC was founded on a single conviction: technology infrastructure should be a growth
accelerator, not a recurring headache. Headquartered in Tampa, Florida, we serve organizations
across the United States that depend on their systems being available, secure, and cost-effective.

Our team combines deep expertise in systems engineering, network design, and cloud architecture with
a practical, outcomes-driven approach. We do not believe in one-size-fits-all solutions. Every
engagement begins with understanding your operational requirements, compliance obligations, and
growth trajectory.

What sets us apart is our integration-first philosophy. Rather than patching together incompatible
tools, we design holistic ecosystems where your hardware, software, and cloud services operate as a
unified platform, reducing complexity and lowering total cost of ownership.

# Technology Infrastructure Engineered for Business Growth

BG HANDYMAN LLC delivers enterprise-grade computer systems design, network architecture, and managed
integration services that keep your operations secure, scalable, and relentlessly online.

What We Do

## Comprehensive Systems Integration

From architecture and deployment to ongoing optimization, we deliver end-to-end technology solutions
that align with your business objectives.

🖥

### Computer Systems Design

Custom infrastructure blueprints engineered for performance, redundancy, and cost efficiency. We
assess your workloads and architect systems that scale with your business.

🌐

### Network Architecture

Secure, high-throughput network designs spanning LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, and wireless. Every topology is
documented, tested, and optimized for zero-downtime operation.

☁

### Cloud Migration & Hybrid

Seamless transitions to AWS, Azure, or private cloud environments. We handle workload assessment,
data migration, and post-migration validation with minimal disruption.

🛡

### Cybersecurity Hardening

Multi-layered defense strategies including endpoint protection, intrusion detection, SIEM
integration, and compliance-ready audit trails for regulated industries.

📈

### Managed IT Operations

24/7 monitoring, patch management, backup orchestration, and help desk escalation. Proactive
maintenance that prevents outages before they impact your users.

🔧

### System Integration & API

Connecting disparate platforms through custom middleware, RESTful APIs, and message queues. Unified
data flows that eliminate manual reconciliation and siloed reporting.

Who We Serve

## Industries We Power

Specialized expertise across regulated, high-availability, and data-intensive sectors where system
reliability is non-negotiable.

#### Healthcare & Life Sciences

HIPAA-compliant infrastructure, EHR integration, and secure telemedicine platforms designed for
clinical workflows and patient data protection.

#### Financial Services & Fintech

Low-latency trading infrastructure, PCI-DSS compliant payment systems, and SOC 2-ready architectures
for banking, insurance, and investment platforms.

#### Logistics & Supply Chain

Real-time inventory tracking, warehouse management system integration, and route optimization
engines that reduce operating costs and improve delivery SLAs.

#### Professional Services

Document management systems, CRM deployments, and unified communications platforms for legal,
accounting, and consulting firms with demanding confidentiality requirements.

#### Manufacturing & Industrial

SCADA integration, IoT sensor networks, and predictive maintenance dashboards connecting factory
floors to executive visibility in real time.

#### Retail & E-Commerce

Omnichannel POS integration, inventory synchronization, and CDN-accelerated storefronts engineered
for Black Friday-scale traffic without performance degradation.

About Us

## Engineering Reliability Into Every System

BG HANDYMAN LLC was founded on a single conviction: technology infrastructure should be a growth
accelerator, not a recurring headache. Headquartered in Tampa, Florida, we serve organizations
across the United States that depend on their systems being available, secure, and cost-effective.

Our team combines deep expertise in systems engineering, network design, and cloud architecture with
a practical, outcomes-driven approach. We do not believe in one-size-fits-all solutions. Every
engagement begins with understanding your operational requirements, compliance obligations, and
growth trajectory.

What sets us apart is our integration-first philosophy. Rather than patching together incompatible
tools, we design holistic ecosystems where your hardware, software, and cloud services operate as a
unified platform, reducing complexity and lowering total cost of ownership.

### Решения для биопроцессов, охватывающие все этапы Вашего биофармацевтического производства

Портфолио Biomirix включает широкую линейку биотехнологического оборудования, охватывающего все
этапы биофармацевтического производства от R&D до коммерческого производства полного цикла. Команда
экспертов и наличие локальной сервисной службы позволяют нам эффективно решать задачи клиентов,
обеспечивать стабильность поставок и предлагать своевременную техническую поддержку.

инактивированных и живых вакцин.

Уникальная технология и материалы, не содержащие РНКаз, для безопасного производства мРНК

### Решения для биопроцессов, охватывающие все этапы Вашего биофармацевтического производства

Портфолио Biomirix включает широкую линейку биотехнологического оборудования, охватывающего все
этапы биофармацевтического производства от R&D до коммерческого производства полного цикла. Команда
экспертов и наличие локальной сервисной службы позволяют нам эффективно решать задачи клиентов,
обеспечивать стабильность поставок и предлагать своевременную техническую поддержку.

качество, безопасность и доступность лекарственных препаратов.

# About Clanwilliam Health (Asia Pacific)

Clanwilliam Health brings together trusted Auckland-based healthcare technology companies HealthLink
and Konnect NET. Both companies are committed to delivering secure healthcare data exchange
solutions to improve the experience of those involved in the healthcare journey. Clanwilliam Health
is based in Auckland with a presence in New Zealand, Australia and Hong Kong. Its software solutions
enable healthcare professionals to provide high quality care across a range of public and private
settings including GP practices, specialist clinics, hospitals, labs, allied health, community
organisations, the insurance sector and more.

**HealthLink** is the leading healthcare system integrator in New Zealand and Australia. Nearly all
secure clinical communications across the New Zealand healthcare system are carried via HealthLink
and it’s the largest provider of secure clinical messaging services in Australia. Established in
1993, HealthLink exchanges more than 100 million clinical messages, including e-Referrals, annually.

[learn more][4]

**Konnect NET** was established in 2008 and is the trusted connection between insurance and
healthcare. It works with insurance partners to retrieve medical information quickly, securely and
effectively. Its SureMed product is used by all major New Zealand insurers to manage health
information requests for underwriting and claims, and its digital claims product is live in the Hong
Kong insurance and medical sectors.

[learn more][5]
Auckland, New Zealand
13-15 Teed Street Newmarket Auckland 1023, New Zealand
Sydney, Australia
Suite 7, Level 7, 44 Market Street, Sydney 2000, Australia

# Welcome to Dräger in India

**Turning technology into “Technology for Life”**

Dräger manufactures medical and safety technology products. In so doing, we protect, support, and
save people's lives around the world in hospitals, with fire departments, emergency services,
authorities, and in mining as well as industry. Founded in Lübeck in 1889, Dräger has grown into a
worldwide, listed enterprise in its fifth generation as a family-run business. Dräger has more than
16,000 employees worldwide and is present in over 190 countries around the globe. In 2023, the
company generated net sales of around EUR 3.4 billion.

Dräger technology is used all over the world. We operate in around 50 countries with our own sales
and service companies directly on location where our customers are.

# Welcome to Dräger in India

**Turning technology into “Technology for Life”**

Dräger manufactures medical and safety technology products. In so doing, we protect, support, and
save people's lives around the world in hospitals, with fire departments, emergency services,
authorities, and in mining as well as industry. Founded in Lübeck in 1889, Dräger has grown into a
worldwide, listed enterprise in its fifth generation as a family-run business. Dräger has more than
16,000 employees worldwide and is present in over 190 countries around the globe. In 2023, the
company generated net sales of around EUR 3.4 billion.

Dräger technology is used all over the world. We operate in around 50 countries with our own sales
and service companies directly on location where our customers are.

[male-doctor-3-2-D-30493-2017]

#### Hospital

Improving critical care is what drives us. Learn how our solutions can help you protect, support and
save lives – across departments and across your hospital.

[Learn more][84]
[Dräger puts safety first with protective equipment for all industrial purposes]

#### Safety

Dräger is a globally recognised name in the field of safety technology. No matter your industry, our
focus is to keep you safe on the job.

[Learn more][85]
[contact-us_safety-3-2]

#### Contact

Get in touch with Dräger. We are happy to help.

[Contact Us][86]

> “Everything we do, we do with passion – and we do it for life.”

Stefan Dräger, Executive Board Chairman

## News, highlights & events

—
[Vista-300-3-2-DMC-104650]

#### Introducing the new Vista 300 patient monitor

An essential patient monitor for adults, paediatrics, and neonates. It is part of a scalable patient
monitoring system that fits securely into your hospital’s network to give you all-time data access
and optimise your workflows.

[Learn more][87]
[caregivers-use-sterile-gear-to-help-prevent-infection-3-2-d-3511-2018]

#### Infection Prevention & Control in Hospitals

Our products are always designed with minimal parts and infection prevention in mind – helping you
to improve workflow efficiency and reduce the risk of such infections in your hospital.

[Learn more][88]
[NICU-Scene-3-2-D-6667-2018]

#### Continually evolving care for newborns

As Your Specialist in Acute Care, we continue developing outstanding technology and delivering
innovative design that is focused on your newborns.

[Learn more][89]
[xnode]

#### Dräger X-node

Dräger X-node is a wireless IoT solution for process monitoring and analysis. The system solution
converts reliable measurement data - gas concentration, temperature, humidity and pressure - from
the X-node device into valuable information that you can access, analyse, visualise, monitor and
store online via the X-node Hub.

[Learn more][90]
[X-plore-8300-carpentry-3-2]

#### Dräger X-plore 8300

Reliable respiratory protection against harmful particles with no noticeable breathing resistance or
restriction to movement: The Dräger X-plore 8300 is the smallest and lightest PAPR device in its
class, offering maximum protection and comfort.

[Learn more][91]
[Main-Suraksha-Parmo-Dharma-v2-3-2]

#### Suraksha Parmo Dharma

As trusted partners, we are dedicated to ensuring that no matter the complexity of the task, you
have Dräger's unwavering support. 

Suraksha Parmo Dharma, a Sanskrit maxim, it means safety is the highest duty. In an era where
workplace hazards, industrial accidents and emergency response risks persist.

[Learn more][92]
[IN-CSR-PCVC-3-2]

#### CSR Initiative Supported by Dräger Safety India

Dräger Safety India proudly announces its successful CSR initiative with PCVC, supporting survivors
of domestic and interpersonal violence, highlighting our commitment to protecting and saving lives.

[Learn more][93]

submit. Once you are you registered you can access the website features.

What if I forgot my username/password?

your account information. If you forget your email address, please contact your sales

EquipNet has been revolutionizing the way companies manage their surplus assets for over two
decades. Our clients range in size from small businesses to Fortune 500 multi-national corporations.
We manage the entire sales and redeployment process, handling a single piece of equipment, or
managing your global investment and redeployment program, including plant closures.

## Buy Equipment

EquipNet is the largest online venue for pre-owned manufacturing, packaging, laboratory, test,
electronics, and facility support equipment. Shop 1,000+ equipment categories across 3 sales
channels.

[MarketPlace™][85]

[Auctions][86]

[Own It Now™][87]

## Sell Equipment

Whether it’s a site closure, a facility reorganization, or simply surplus equipment, EquipNet will
manage the sales process ensuring maximum cash value recovered.

[List an Item for Sale][88]

[List Multiple Items For Sale][89]

[Plant Closures & Projects][90]

## Manage Equipment

EquipNet’s proprietary technology (ARMS™), along with turnkey capabilities deliver a professionally
managed investment recovery and redeployment program.

[Global Programs][91]

[Regional Programs][92]

[Multiple Plant Programs][93]

## Client Success Stories

### Biotech/Pharmaceutical Facility Closure: Massachusetts

One of our previous project clients recommended our services to Synta Pharmaceuticals to help with
closing a facility consisting of three different buildings. The entire facility needed full
clearance and contained an array of over 400 pieces of R&D equipment.
[Read More][105]

### The Success of Buying & Selling Equipment with EquipNet

EquipNet is constantly working on asset disposition projects with multiple clients across the globe
to help companies buy, sell, and manage their surplus. This case study outlines how EquipNet was
able to help our long-term client buying and selling. 
[Read More][106]

### Cookie Production Line: Colombia

This client originally sought out an auctioneer company to help sell a cookie production line from a
facility in Colombia. When the company was unsuccessful in its efforts, the auctioneer directly
reached out to EquipNet for expert assistance. 
[Read More][107]
[View More][108]

## One accountable partner for compliant water

HydroCare designs, installs, tests, and documents water for two demanding markets — dialysis centers
under AAMI and CMS, and sterile processing departments under the 2023 ANSI/AAMI ST108 standard. Most
vendors sell you the equipment and leave the compliance to you. We own it end to end — the system,
the testing, and the survey-ready documentation — so when a surveyor asks, one team is accountable,
not a patchwork of vendors.
* Expert knowledge of AAMI and ST108 water regulations, microbiology testing and validation.
* Experienced in consulting, designing, servicing and installing water systems
* Post-warranty servicing of your systems
* ST108-compliant sterile processing water
* Nationwide standardized pricing
* Partnerships offer a single-contract solution

## Water systems, simplified by biomedical experts

HydroCare handles every aspect in the life cycle of medical-grade water purification systems across
a variety of applications. We see the unmet need of simplifying the design, installation, and
maintenance of water systems for providers and are the only total water system provider focused
solely on the needs of Dialysis providers. Our water systems are certified, 510k registered medical
devices that meet or exceed the most rigorous FDA, CMS, AAMI and ISO 13959:2014 standards.
* Expert knowledge of water purification regulations, microbiology testing and validation
* Experienced in consulting, designing, servicing and installing water systems
* Post-warranty servicing of your systems
* Expertise in sterile processing services
* Nationwide standardized pricing
* Partnerships offer a single-contract solution

As the preferred partner for dialysis providers, HydroCare stands as a champion in the field. We

stringent standards set by the FDA, CMS, AAMI, and ISO 13959:2014. Our team of biomedical experts

water.

# Precision Valves Engineered for Process Excellence

### Unmatched Reliability, Hygienic Design, and Superior Control

Maximize uptime, safeguard product purity, and streamline compliance with Bürkert’s
precision-engineered process valves and automation systems. Designed specifically for Pharma and
Biopharma, our innovative solutions ensure dependable operation, easy integration, and the highest
standards of hygiene and safety.

[Learn More][71]

# Your On-Demand Solution

### for Aflex Pharmaline and Bioflex Ultra Hoses

Discover the convenience of our on-demand Aflex Pharmaline and Bioflex Ultra hoses, featuring a
swift 48-hour turnaround. Experience superior quality and reliability for all your sanitary hose
assembly needs. Order now for fast, efficient service!

[Learn More][72]

# QUATTROFLOW Q-CONTROL

### SMART CONTROL OF YOUR BIOTECH PUMP OPERATIONS

Q-Control is an integrated pump controller for Quattroflow® multiple-use and single-use pumps. It
interfaces with a variety of flow and pressure sensors to provide the user with automated control
over their pump operations. With built-in smart control functions that no longer require an external
PLC, Q-Control leads to a new generation of Quattroflow biotech pumps.

##### Products

## Mobile Medical Facilities & Modular Medical Facilities for Temporary or Permanent Use

> For Lease, Rent or Purchase

#### Delivering Temporary or Permanent Mobile Medical & Modular Medical Facilities that Meet Any
#### Medical Needs.

Mod Build, LLC delivers in a short time various mobile medical & modular medical healthcare
facilities, which can be leased, rented or purchased for temporary or permanent use. Our mobile
medical & modular medical facilities can be used in any department within a hospital, medical
center, clinic, or elsewhere. Easily transportable and installed, these mobile medical & modular
medical facilities are code compliant for temporary use as ‘swing space’, during a renovation or
construction project, or emergency. Or, it can be for permanent use to increase much needed
additional space and capacity, resulting in increased revenues.

#### Renovation, Construction Project or simply needing additional capacity:

Medical healthcare facilities are constantly experiencing challenges to provide upgraded services in
older and aging facilities. As a result, when these construction projects are underway, they can and
do cause disruptions to services, patients and staff.

#### Solution

Use Mod Build’s temporary mobile medical or temporary modular medical healthcare facility during any
renovation or construction project. Our temporary facility will be located and accessible on your
medical facility’s campus, with or without a connecting corridor, causing no disruption to the host
facility, while either continuing or capturing new services and revenues.

[ All Products ][13]

## Some of our modular products include
## departments, suites and rooms for:
* Sterile Processing Department
* Modular Surgical Facilities
* Modular Operating Room(s)
* Modular Hybrid OR(s)
* Modular Endoscopy
* Modular Cath Lab(s)
* Modular Emergency Department
* Modular Trauma
* Modular ICU
* Modular Patient care
* Modular Dialysis
* Modular Isolation and containment
* Modular Mammography
* Modular Clinic(s)
* Modular Office(s)
* Modular Micro or entire Hospital

## Some of our mobile products include
## departments, suites and rooms for:
* Mobile Surgical Facilities
* Mobile Operating Room(s)
* Mobile Endoscopy
* Mobile ICU
* Mobile Isolation and Containment
* Mobile Mammography
* Mobile Clinics
* Mobile Surgery Unit
* Mobile Dental Units
* Mobile Surgery Center

## A Few Words About Us

**MOBILE & MODULAR MEDICAL CONSTRUCTION**

**ABOUT MOBILE MEDICAL FACILITIES**

**Benefits**
* No disruption to medical facility operations
* Temporary or permanent use
* Regulatory compliant
* Exceptional consistency and quality
* Multi-configurable
* Off-site construction
* New construction ready for use in about 6 months

**ABOUT MODULAR MEDICAL FACILITIES**

**Benefits**
* Off-site construction 
* Minimal to no disruption of medical facility operations
* Exceptional consistency and quality 
* Speed to Market – built in a matter of months instead of years as with site-built facilities
* Sustainable construction
* Cost certainty

Precision bioprocessing solutions, engineered.manufactured.delivered.proven.engineered.

Some problems don't have an off-the-shelf answer. MonoBiologics was founded to solve them. We design
and manufacture precision single-use bioprocessing solutions — developing proprietary technology
where the industry needed it most, and building bespoke systems where standard just isn't good
enough.

Why MonoBiologics?

## Built for the complexity of modern bioprocessing

From a single precision component to a fully integrated bespoke system, MonoBiologics exists to
remove friction from your process — wherever you are in the world.

End-to-End

### Component to Complete System

Single-use pumps, valves, valve manifolds, bags, flow path assemblies, LSR overmolding and fully
integrated bespoke process systems — all under one roof.

100%

### Bespoke Engineering Capability

Every system we build is engineered to your exact process requirements — TFFI skids, buffer prep,
viral inactivation, and beyond. No off-the-shelf compromise.

USPClass VI

### Quality You Can Validate

Our single-use components meet USP Class VI biocompatibility standards, with full traceability and
regulatory documentation to support your validation programme.

IE / Global

### Irish-Rooted, Delivering Globally

Headquartered in Waterford, Ireland — at the centre of Europe's biopharma corridor — with direct
access to global supply chains, responsive lead times, and hands-on support wherever you
manufacture.

2020

### Supply Chain You Can Rely On

Founded in 2020 and growing year on year, we've built a resilient supply network and deep inventory
capability to keep your process moving — even when global supply chains don't.

What We Do

## A complete single-use platform —
## from component to complete system

Every valve, pump, assembly, and system we supply is precision-engineered for biopharma. One
supplier. Full accountability.

# [Midjourney’s ultrasound spa pitch draws imaging scrutiny][18]

The generative AI firm says its Ultrasonic CT system will start with body-composition maps, while
Butterfly disclosed a 5-year deal worth up to $74M.

[RadiologySignal.com writers][19]·June 19, 2026

## Latest

[
[MRgFUS trial reports Parkinson motor-complication gains]
][20]
[Clinical][21]

### [MRgFUS trial reports Parkinson motor-complication gains][22]

The prospective multicenter trial used Insightec’s Exablate Neuro system in 54 patients and reported
a 66.8% motor-complication improvement after bilateral treatment.

[RadiologySignal.com writers][23]·Jun 18, 2026

[
[IR workload narrows across U.S. radiologist workforce]
][24]
[Practice][25]

### [IR workload narrows across U.S. radiologist workforce][26]

A Medicare claims analysis found that fewer radiologists performed any IR-related work from 2008 to
2023, while higher-IR workloads became more concentrated.

[RadiologySignal.com writers][27]·Jun 18, 2026

[
[FluoroSpeed X1 ST adds dose reporting and positioning aids]
][28]
[Business][29]

### [FluoroSpeed X1 ST adds dose reporting and positioning aids][30]

Shimadzu Medical Systems USA’s latest R/F table configuration includes a 17-inch x 17-inch
flat-panel detector, bariatric-capable table loading, wheelchair access, and ST workflow features.

[RadiologySignal.com writers][31]·Jun 17, 2026

[
[Hepatoscope adds FDA-cleared liver-fat quantification]
][32]
[Clinical][33]

### [Hepatoscope adds FDA-cleared liver-fat quantification][34]

E-Scopics said its Hepatoscope-Derived Fat Fraction combines ultrasound attenuation and
backscattering coefficient measurements to estimate intrahepatic fat at the point of care.

[RadiologySignal.com writers][35]·Jun 17, 2026

[
[Resorbable microspheres show 12-month GAE pain gains]
][36]
[Clinical][37]

### [Resorbable microspheres show 12-month GAE pain gains][38]

A Radiology study of 194 patients found sustained pain reduction and functional improvement after
genicular artery embolization for osteoarthritis-related knee pain.

[RadiologySignal.com writers][39]·Jun 17, 2026

[
[Breast biopsy needle shortage now extends into 2027]
][40]
[Practice][41]

### [Breast biopsy needle shortage now extends into 2027][42]

FDA now expects stereotactic breast biopsy needle supply disruption to continue through March 2027
and is advising providers to conserve available devices.

[RadiologySignal.com writers][43]·Jun 17, 2026

[
[Virginia radiology group sues hospital partner]
][44]
[Practice][45]

### [Virginia radiology group sues hospital partner][46]

Virginia Medical Imaging is seeking at least $2.65M from Mary Washington Healthcare in a dispute
over joint-venture governance, contract negotiations, and outpatient imaging operations.

[RadiologySignal.com writers][47]·Jun 17, 2026

[
[Emory shifts 1.3M annual imaging exams to Sectra cloud]
][48]
[Business][49]

### [Emory shifts 1.3M annual imaging exams to Sectra cloud][50]

The 11-hospital Georgia academic health system has moved its enterprise imaging IT infrastructure to
Sectra’s fully managed cloud service under a 5-year agreement.

[RadiologySignal.com writers][51]·Jun 17, 2026

[
[AIRS Medical gets TA backing for MRI AI expansion]
][52]
[Business][53]

### [AIRS Medical gets TA backing for MRI AI expansion][54]

The strategic growth investment will support AIRS Medical’s international expansion and product
development across SwiftMR and SwiftSight. Financial terms were not disclosed.

[RadiologySignal.com writers][55]·Jun 16, 2026

## PharmaTainer^{™} Bottle Solutions

Outstandingly clean and strong, our PharmaTainer^{™} Bottles are manufactured with ADCF virgin
medical-grade resins in an ISO 5-classified environment, certified sterile SAL 10-6 and conform to
USP788 and USP85. Available in 10 mL to 20 L in PET or PC, they’re ideal for sterile liquid
transfer, storage, and transport including vaccines, biopharmaceuticals, culture media, and other
biotech materials.

[Learn More][150]

## Cap2V8^{®} Bottle & Cap Assemblies

Our Cap2V8^{®} cap is a one-piece molded tube-and-cap system that works seamlessly with your chosen
container to create a closed sterile system that protects product integrity, provides an aseptic
seal for high-purity biologicals, and reduces the possibility of contamination and product loss
often associated with manual processes and designs.

[Learn More][151]

## Tubing

With decades of experience manufacturing various thermoplastic and silicone tubing products for the
bioprocessing industry, our growing extrusion capability includes over 15 extruders worldwide and an
extensive stocking program in Europe and the US. We offer three primary forms: custom single-use
assemblies and systems, bulk tubing, and custom-cut lengths.

[Learn More][152]

## aSURE^{™} Instrument Tees

By incorporating an elastomeric diaphragm into a sanitary instrument fitting, without using solvents
or adhesives, this gendered connection point accepts virtually any standard 1.5″ sanitary pressure
sensor.

[Learn More][153]

## Clamps

Our non-metallic sanitary clamps, both single-use and reusable, allow you to confidently adhere to
regulatory compliance and ensure seal integrity. They’re available in a range of pack counts and
sizes from 3/4″ – 4” with additional options including color-coded knobs, custom laser engraving and
custom packaging.

[Learn More][154]

## Fittings

Offering one of the widest ranges of fittings available from a single source, SaniSure® is a leader
in the sanitary non-metallic fittings category. You can choose from a vast selection of reducers,
adapters, barbs, tees, elbows, gaskets, end caps, diaphragms, and more with most inventory in stock
for quick fulfillment.

[Learn More][155]

## Filling Needles

Fill4Sure^{™} filling needles offer a needle for every drug product application or filling machine.
Made from premium 316L stainless steel with polycarbonate housings in an oil- and adhesive-free
manufacturing process, they’re available both ready-made and tailormade for 100% coverage across the
fill-finish arena, uncoupling the restrictions posed by OEM needles.

[Learn More][156]

## Gamma Stable Stir Bars

SaniSure® Gamma Stable Stir Bars are ideal for the simple agitation of biopharmaceutical process
solutions. Available standalone or integrated into a variety of container formats, they provide a
simple mixing solution and process flexibility. Available in various sizes to suit the desired
container volume, they are Animal Derived Components Free (ADCF), meet USP Class VI, and are lot
traceable.

indicators.

#### Insight Development

#### Actionable Deliverables

#### Follow Through and Measurement

Support in defining KPIs and tracking how decisions influence revenue, margin and risk over time.

organisations make better revenue decisions.

next”.

to expand, where to hold and where to exit. The result is sharper focus and better use of capital.

Clear evidence and simple narratives make it easier to align leadership teams, secure stakeholder
buy in and move at speed. Our team remains available beyond the report handover to test assumptions
and refine plans.

# Smart Biotech Solutions to scale from lab to production with confidence.

## [Bioreactor Solutions][111]

### [from 0.5 to 2000L][112]

[Bioreactors][113]

## [Tangential Flow Filtration Solutions][114]

### [from 0.1 m² to 65 m² ][115]

[Tangential Flow Filtration][116]

## [Supplies][117]

### [Single Use Bags | Flowkits | Vessels][118]

[Supplies][119]

## Lab-scale solutions for Bioprocessing

Single-use & multi-use Bioreactors and TFF systems for lab-scale processes. Suitable for mAbs,
vaccines, recombinant proteins, and cell & gene therapy. Volumes up to 10 L | Membrane area up to
0.7 m².

[Lab-scale solutions][120]
**eLAB TFF Single-Use**
Compact TFF system designed for lab-scale concentration and diafiltration processes. Single-use flow
path ensures quick setup and easy cleaning.

**Membrane area:** up to 0.7 m²
**eLAB Essential**
Compact and easy-to-use bioreactor designed for academic research and early-stage development. Ideal
for microbial and cell culture processes at lab scale.

**Volumes:** 0.3 to 5 L
**eLAB TFF**
Multi-use TFF system for lab-scale concentration, diafiltration, and clarification. Compatible with
cassette, hollow fiber, and ceramic membranes.

**Membrane area:** up to 0.7 m²

## Pilot-scale solutions for Bioprocessing

Single-use & multi-use TFF systems, Bioreactors, and supplies for process development and scale-up.
Designed for mAbs, vaccines, and recombinant protein production. Volumes up to 50 L | Membrane area
up to 2.5 m².

[Pilot-scale solutions][121]
**ePilot Bioreactor SU**
Dual-use single-use bioreactor for pilot-scale applications. Suitable for both microbial and cell
culture processes, combining flexibility and scalability with reduced cleaning needs.

**Volumes:** 30 to 50 L
**ePLUS SU Mixer**
Single-use mixing system for media and buffer preparation. Designed for fast setup, efficient
mixing, and reduced cleaning time.

**Volumes:** 50 to 500 L
**eBAG 3D Mixer**
Single-use 3D mixing bag for efficient homogenization of media and buffers. Designed for closed
systems with bottom magnetic stirring and top handle for easy handling.

**Volumes:** 50 to 500 L
**ePilot Bioreactor MU**
Multi-use bioreactor for pilot-scale microbial and cell culture processes. Designed for process
development and scale-up with full automation and control.

**Volumes:** 30 to 50 L
**ePLUS CIP**
Automated Clean-in-Place system designed for cleaning tanks, bioreactors, and process lines. Ensures
consistent cleaning performance with customizable recipes.

**Volumes:** up to 2,000L
**ePilot TFF MU**
Multi-use TFF system for pilot-scale concentration, clarification, and diafiltration. Compatible
with cassette, hollow fiber, and ceramic membranes.

**Membrane area:** up to 2.5 m²
**eBAG 3D STR**
Single-use 3D bag designed for stirred-tank bioreactors. Optimized for cell culture processes with
bottom magnetic stirring and secure top ports.

**Volumes:** 50 to 1000L

## Production-scale solutions for Bioprocessing

Single & multi-use Bioreactors, TFF systems and process supplies for large-scale bioproduction. For
mAbs, vaccines, recombinant proteins. Volumes up to 2000 L | Membrane area up to 65 m².

[Production-scale solutions][122]
**eProd Bioreactor SU**
Single-use bioreactor for large-scale microbial and cell culture processes. Designed for commercial
manufacturing with advanced control and scalable configuration.

**Volumes:** up to 4,000 L
**eProd TFF**
Multi-use TFF system for large-scale concentration, clarification, and diafiltration. Compatible
with cassette, hollow fiber, and ceramic membranes.

**Membrane area:** up to 65 m²
**eProd Bioreactor MU**
Multi-use bioreactor for large-scale bioproduction. Designed for microbial and cell culture
processes with stainless steel vessels and integrated control systems.

**Volumes:** up to 2000 L
**eBAG 3D STR**
Single-use 3D bag designed for stirred-tank bioreactors. Optimized for cell culture applications
with bottom magnetic stirring and top ports for secure integration.

**Volumes:** 30 to 1000 L
**ePLUS SU Mixer**
Single-use mixing system for media preparation and buffer formulation. Ensures fast setup, easy
operation, and reliable mixing performance.

**Volumes:** 50 to 500 L
**ePLUS CIP**
Automated Clean-in-Place system designed for cleaning tanks, bioreactors, and process lines. Ensures
consistent cleaning performance with customizable recipes.

**Volumes:** up to 2,000L

## Lab-scale solutions for Bioprocessing

Single-use & multi-use Bioreactors and TFF systems for lab-scale processes. Suitable for mAbs,
vaccines, recombinant proteins, and cell & gene therapy. Volumes up to 10 L | Membrane area up to
0.7 m².

[Lab-scale solutions][120]
**eLAB TFF Single-Use**
Compact TFF system designed for lab-scale concentration and diafiltration processes. Single-use flow
path ensures quick setup and easy cleaning.

**Membrane area:** up to 0.7 m²
**eLAB Essential**
Compact and easy-to-use bioreactor designed for academic research and early-stage development. Ideal
for microbial and cell culture processes at lab scale.

**Volumes:** 0.3 to 5 L
**eLAB TFF**
Multi-use TFF system for lab-scale concentration, diafiltration, and clarification. Compatible with
cassette, hollow fiber, and ceramic membranes.

**Membrane area:** up to 0.7 m²

## Pilot-scale solutions for Bioprocessing

Single-use & multi-use TFF systems, Bioreactors, and supplies for process development and scale-up.
Designed for mAbs, vaccines, and recombinant protein production. Volumes up to 50 L | Membrane area
up to 2.5 m².

[Pilot-scale solutions][121]
**ePilot Bioreactor SU**
Dual-use single-use bioreactor for pilot-scale applications. Suitable for both microbial and cell
culture processes, combining flexibility and scalability with reduced cleaning needs.

**Volumes:** 30 to 50 L
**ePLUS SU Mixer**
Single-use mixing system for media and buffer preparation. Designed for fast setup, efficient
mixing, and reduced cleaning time.

**Volumes:** 50 to 500 L
**eBAG 3D Mixer**
Single-use 3D mixing bag for efficient homogenization of media and buffers. Designed for closed
systems with bottom magnetic stirring and top handle for easy handling.

**Volumes:** 50 to 500 L
**ePilot Bioreactor MU**
Multi-use bioreactor for pilot-scale microbial and cell culture processes. Designed for process
development and scale-up with full automation and control.

**Volumes:** 30 to 50 L
**ePLUS CIP**
Automated Clean-in-Place system designed for cleaning tanks, bioreactors, and process lines. Ensures
consistent cleaning performance with customizable recipes.

**Volumes:** up to 2,000L
**ePilot TFF MU**
Multi-use TFF system for pilot-scale concentration, clarification, and diafiltration. Compatible
with cassette, hollow fiber, and ceramic membranes.

**Membrane area:** up to 2.5 m²
**eBAG 3D STR**
Single-use 3D bag designed for stirred-tank bioreactors. Optimized for cell culture processes with
bottom magnetic stirring and secure top ports.

**Volumes:** 50 to 1000L

## Production-scale solutions for Bioprocessing

Single & multi-use Bioreactors, TFF systems and process supplies for large-scale bioproduction. For
mAbs, vaccines, recombinant proteins. Volumes up to 2000 L | Membrane area up to 65 m².

[Production-scale solutions][122]
**eProd Bioreactor SU**
Single-use bioreactor for large-scale microbial and cell culture processes. Designed for commercial
manufacturing with advanced control and scalable configuration.

**Volumes:** up to 4,000 L
**eProd TFF**
Multi-use TFF system for large-scale concentration, clarification, and diafiltration. Compatible
with cassette, hollow fiber, and ceramic membranes.

**Membrane area:** up to 65 m²
**eProd Bioreactor MU**
Multi-use bioreactor for large-scale bioproduction. Designed for microbial and cell culture
processes with stainless steel vessels and integrated control systems.

**Volumes:** up to 2000 L
**eBAG 3D STR**
Single-use 3D bag designed for stirred-tank bioreactors. Optimized for cell culture applications
with bottom magnetic stirring and top ports for secure integration.

**Volumes:** 30 to 1000 L
**ePLUS SU Mixer**
Single-use mixing system for media preparation and buffer formulation. Ensures fast setup, easy
operation, and reliable mixing performance.

**Volumes:** 50 to 500 L
**ePLUS CIP**
Automated Clean-in-Place system designed for cleaning tanks, bioreactors, and process lines. Ensures
consistent cleaning performance with customizable recipes.

**Volumes:** up to 2,000L

# Powering Progress in Biotech

Delivering state-of-the-art technology, engineering and automation services to the biotech industry.

What We Do

## Driving progress in biotech research and biomanufacturing

We believe in the power of science and medicine to solve health problems and make lives better—today
and in the future. As a pioneering partner to the biotech industry we do our part to drive this
progress by supporting upstream and downstream bioprocesses from the lab to commercial production,
with state-of-the-art equipment, engineering and automation services. We bring fresh perspectives
and unique solutions, to power possibilities for a better tomorrow.

[Our Products][40]
[Our Services][41]
[Tezalon - Who We Are]

Who We are

## A pioneering partner to the biotech industry

Tezalon is a division of Innovative Engineering Systems, founded in 2002. We leverage our years of
experience, insights and technological innovations to add unique value to the fast-moving biotech
industry, guided by the values of integrity, innovation, and resilience. We are committed to pushing
the limits, exceeding expectations, and delivering excellence at every level.

[LEARN MORE][42]

WHY PARTNER WITH US

## Committed to your success

What sets us apart is our commitment to the success of our customers. This is how we do it…****

#### End-to-End Solutions

We support your bioprocess from research and development to full-scale manufacturing.

#### Custom Solutions

We listen to our customers and develop solutions that meet their specific requirements.

#### Ease of Integration

Our products are tailored to the unique needs of each client and easy to integrate with open
automation platforms.

#### Client-Centered

We employ a collaborative and supportive process that fosters long-term business relationship.

#### Excellence & Integrity

We don’t compromise on quality, and we stand behind what we do.

#### Industry Experts

Our extensive industry knowledge includes FDA and other regulatory requirements, under which our
customers operate.

Social Impact

## Focused on corporate responsibility

At Tezalon, we believe that we have a responsibility to both our planet and our people. Contributing
to a healthy environment, conserving natural resources, as well as supporting the well-being of our
employees and our customers are our highest priorities. Our company policies, practices and
strategies will always be consistent with these core principles.

[LEARN MORE][43]

Delivering state-of-the-art technology, engineering and automation services to the biotech industry.

What We Do

## Driving progress in biotech research and biomanufacturing

We believe in the power of science and medicine to solve health problems and make lives better—today
and in the future. As a pioneering partner to the biotech industry we do our part to drive this
progress by supporting upstream and downstream bioprocesses from the lab to commercial production,
with state-of-the-art equipment, engineering and automation services. We bring fresh perspectives
and unique solutions, to power possibilities for a better tomorrow.

Tezalon is a division of Innovative Engineering Systems, founded in 2002. We leverage our years of

automation platforms.

customers operate.

to a healthy environment, conserving natural resources, as well as supporting the well-being of our
employees and our customers are our highest priorities. Our company policies, practices and
strategies will always be consistent with these core principles.

processing for monitoring the silicate and conductivity values in accordance with the latest DGSV
recommendations.

* Available as 4 or 8 channel system

* Software architecture for integration of Testomat EVO, Testomat 2000, Testomat LAB, Testomat 808,

* Ethernet interface for network integration
* Visualization of status messages and measured values via web interface
