### **Why HeylNeomeris clinical solutions?**

We at HeylNeomeris are your competent partner when it comes to services and products in the field of
water treatment for the outpatient and large hospital sector.

*Our competence and expertise united for you under HeylNeomeris clinical solutions.*

 

### **Services **

HeylNeomeris clinical solutions offers comprehensive consulting for your sterile processing
procedures. With our expertise, we ensure process quality, from water treatment to the provision of
sterile medical devices. Our aim is to ensure safe and efficient sterile processing that meets the
highest quality standards. Our solutions and products reflect the latest state of knowledge and
technology. We are guided by recommendations 17 and 18 of the DGSV’s Hygiene, Construction and
Technology Committee. This enables us to guarantee your legally compliant water treatment.
[Guidelines of the DGSV][46]

Heyl Neomeris clinical solutions offers a comprehensive range of services for the outpatient and
large hospital sector.

**The following is an excerpt from our service portfolio:**
1. **Water treatment:** We offer solutions and products for water treatment in your hospital that
   comply with legal standards, guidelines and the stricter recommendations of the DGSV.
   [Modular cabinet system for large treatment capacities][47][Under-sink system for low treatment
   capacities][48]
2. **Sterile processing:** We advise clinics on the implementation and optimisation of processes
   from water treatment to processed sterile goods in order to sustainably protect medical devices
   and ensure a high level of patient safety.
   [Sterile processing][49]
3. **Consulting:** We offer professional consulting services to discuss individual requirements and
   challenges and develop customised solutions.
4. **Short check:** The short check is a detailed analysis in which our experts check the processes
   on site. This can help to identify bottlenecks, improve quality and reduce costs.
5. **Customer-specific process analysis:** We carry out comprehensive analyses of process flows to
   identify weaknesses and develop efficient solutions.
6. **Individualised or special solutions:** These are customised approaches that are tailored to the
   specific requirements of each customer. This can include the development of new technologies, the
   customisation of existing systems or the integration of solutions into existing infrastructures.
   [Solution Building][50]

Water treatment for sterile goods and medical devices in outpatient centres is a crucial step in
ensuring the quality of deionised water even in smaller reprocessing units or discontinuous
reprocessing processes and in carrying out the subsequent reprocessing processes.

Water treatment and consulting are always customised to your specific needs. For this reason, we
offer a product configurator for our modular water treatment plant.

The modular water treatment system is a development from our company and was developed specifically
for the outpatient care sector. It can be adapted to different circumstances, including different
degrees of water hardness, required quantities and the initial water quality. We offer this product
as a cabinet system and as an under-counter version. For smaller quantities of treated demineralised
water and discontinuous treatment, choose the under-counter version; for larger quantities, choose
the cabinet system.

 

**Our solution concept, as a cabinet system, offers a number of advantages:**
1. **Space-saving:** Only a minimum footprint of 1.60 m x 1 m is required to set up the cabinet
   system. It consists of two cabinets, each 80 cm wide and 60 cm deep.
2. **Modular concept:** The system can be optionally equipped with a multicontroller system, the
   NeoTecMaster®. The multicontroller concept enables the external monitoring of relevant water
   parameters such as silicate or conductivity. You can also add a lifting system, a UV system and
   pyrogen filters for disinfection as well as drip pans to your cabinet system.
3. **Customisability:** The water treatment system can be adapted to the different degrees of water
   hardness in Germany and the quantities required in different facilities.
4. **Financing and warranty:** We offer a selection of financing options, including rental models,
   as well as the option of an extended warranty for our Testomat products.
   [Leasing, rental, & financing models][51]

The modular cabinet system and the under-counter version are a market innovation for the reliable
and efficient treatment of demineralised water in the outpatient sector.

As you can see, our solutions, services and products are designed to ensure the best possible
deionised water quality in your treatment, to protect medical devices and equipment and to optimise
the treatment process in outpatient clinics.

HeylNeomeris clinical solution is a competent partner for all process water issues in the medical
sector, whether large clinics, medical care centres or outpatient practices.

**With us, you have the expertise and competence for a safe water treatment process in sterile
processing at your side.**

The HeylNeomeris team will be happy to provide you with additional information or personal advice.
